definition: Manages a portfolio of customer accounts and renews customer contracts.
Sells products to new customers and closes deals.
Maintains sales forecasts and territories and prepares pipeline reports.
Explains the technical side of products during a sale and runs product demonstrations.
Finds new sales leads by outreach and qualifies leads for the sales team.
Helps existing customers adopt products and keeps customers satisfied after the sale.
Generic role for the Sales family.
Builds budgets and forecasts and explains variances against plan.
Keeps the general ledger and prepares monthly accounts.
Runs payroll and resolves pay queries.
Tests internal controls and reports findings to the audit committee.
Processes supplier invoices and schedules payments.
Manages cash positions and bank accounts and arranges short-term funding.
Generic role for the Finance family.
Sources candidates and fills open positions.
Advises managers on staffing and performance and handles employee relations cases.
Benchmarks pay against the market and maintains salary bands.
Enrols employees in health and retirement plans and answers benefits questions.
Designs training courses and delivers courses to employees.
Keeps employee records and schedules onboarding for new hires.
Generic role for the Human Resources family.
Designs and writes application code and reviews changes before release.
Queries data and builds dashboards and explains trends to the business.
Runs servers and networks and manages user accounts.
Resolves hardware and software problems for employees and sets up laptops and phones.
Monitors systems for threats and investigates security incidents.
Writes test plans and verifies releases before launch.
Generic role for the Technology family.
Runs daily site operations and improves processes.
Plans inventory levels and analyses supplier performance.
Picks and packs orders and loads goods for shipment.
Schedules shipments and tracks deliveries with carriers.
Sources suppliers and negotiates prices and issues purchase orders.
Inspects sites for hazards and enforces safety regulations.
Generic role for the Operations family.
Plans campaigns and manages the marketing budget.
Writes articles and web pages and edits product copy.
Creates visual designs for campaigns and maintains brand materials.
Runs paid search and email campaigns and manages social media channels.
Surveys customers and analyses market trends and competitors.
Prepares press releases and writes internal announcements.
Generic role for the Marketing family.
Advises the business on contracts and disputes and interprets corporate law.
Prepares legal documents and supports counsel on filings.
Monitors adherence to regulations and reports breaches to regulators.
Drafts commercial contracts and tracks renewal dates.
Assesses how personal data is handled and answers data subject requests.
Assesses operational and regulatory risks and maintains the risk register.
Generic role for the Legal family.
Answers customer questions by phone, email and chat and logs each contact.
Troubleshoots product problems reported by customers and documents fixes.
Supervises a team of agents and monitors call quality.
Resolves invoice disputes and adjusts customer bills.
Analyses satisfaction surveys and reports complaint trends.
Processes product returns and arranges refunds and exchanges.
Generic role for the Customer Service family.
